comparison.objective: Candidate breaks and recovers insert tangs; record locks a floating guide rod so a carriage can traverse fully and return.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires coaxial hammering and fragment recovery; record requires positioning/clamping a loose guide rod and operating a crank to validate travel.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four undamaged completions and full fragment containment; record requires full outbound-and-return carriage travel without sticking, followed by release.
comparison.reason: Alignment and locking validated by carriage motion differ from fracture and loose-debris recovery.
